Name: GMCM Search and Sort
Author: aerinanxiety
Description:
[center]I made this mostly for myself since the alternatives didn't have a sort by newest function.[/center]
[center]
Sort + Search both work right by hooking into GMCM directly. No new menus. It's a little search bar at the top of the page. Also usable in-game with most changes immediate.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Sort by Author, Z-A, A-Z, and by Newest.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img width=157]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55318/55318-1794507527-232828154.png[/img][/center]
[center]Make sure you have GMCM installed, download this manually [b](no vortex!)[/b], unzip, and drop it into your mods folder.[/center]

Manifest.Name: GMCM Search & Sort
Manifest.Description: Adds a search bar and sort options to Generic Mod Config Menu's mod list.
Manifest.Author: aerinanxiety
